summary: Dependency-confusion payload exfiltrates CI/cloud credentials via native addon on import
details: On require(), index.js unconditionally loads prebuilds/linux-x64/metrics.node. The native addon reads AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, NODE_AUTH_TOKEN, SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN, ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN, and ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN from the environment along with hostname, user, and cwd, and sends them in a JSON body to oob.s4yhii.com over a raw TCP socket (POST /native HTTP/1.0). fork+setsid is used to detach the exfil process from the parent. A nested manifest at src/archetype/package.json carries the self-identifying marker '_marker: s4yhii-dependency-confusion-poc-2026-10-09' and contact 'jesusitpro22@gmail.com', consistent with a dependency-confusion payload targeting the @galicia-toolkit-nestjs-20/* scope so that an internal package name resolves to this public lookalike on CI/developer machines.
